I want to create a toy car model. Create a box with dimensions 200x100x100(X,Y,Z) as the body. The windshield can be created by subtracting a 50x100x50 block from an upper edge of the box. Add four wheels with a radius of 25 and a thickness of 10: Place two at (25,0,0) and (175,0,0) facing in the Y-Axis (0,1,0), and two at (25,100,0) and (175,100,0) facing in the negative Y-Axis (0,-1,0). | First, describe in words and step by step how the user's request can be implemented using function calls only. After the description, I will ask you to prepare the function call for execution, but don't execute it until I explicitly request it.

Step-by-step plan (no function calls yet)

1. Make the car body  
   • Add one rectangular block  
     – Base point (0 , 0 , 0)  
     – Size: X = 200, Y = 100, Z = 100  
     – subtraction = False (first volume establishes the solid)

2. Carve out the windshield recess  
   • Subtract one block  
     – Base point (150 , 0 , 50) – this touches the upper-front edge of the body  
     – Size: X = 50, Y = 100, Z = 50  
     – subtraction = True (removes that volume)

3. Add the four wheels (cylinders)  
   Geometry set-up: each wheel is a short cylinder, radius = 25, thickness = 10  
   a. Front-left wheel (faces +Y)  
      – baseCenter (25 , 0 , 25)            – sits flush with the outside of the body  
      – heightVector (0 , 10 , 0)           – 10 mm inward along +Y  
      – radius 25, subtraction = False  

   b. Front-right wheel (faces −Y)  
      – baseCenter (25 , 100 , 25)          – opposite side of the body  
      – heightVector (0 , −10 , 0)          – 10 mm inward along −Y  
      – radius 25, subtraction = False  

   c. Rear-left wheel (faces +Y)  
      – baseCenter (175 , 0 , 25)  
      – heightVector (0 , 10 , 0)  
      – radius 25, subtraction = False  

   d. Rear-right wheel (faces −Y)  
      – baseCenter (175 , 100 , 25)  
      – heightVector (0 , −10 , 0)  
      – radius 25, subtraction = False  

4. Finish  
   • After the block and cylinder calls, issue the finished() call.

If this layout is acceptable, ask me to prepare the corresponding function calls.
